matchupOfTheWeek.title: Rush Offense vs. Run Defense
matchupOfTheWeek.description: Our rush offense grades in the 68th percentile against a unit that grades 42nd — the widest real statistical edge on the board this week.

previewTake: Here's the thing about Week 3: we've finally got a genuinely asymmetrical matchup on our hands, and it's happening on the ground. Our rush offense is operating in the 68th percentile against Jacksonville's run defense that grades 42nd—that's the widest real statistical edge on the entire board this week, which means if we're serious about getting right, this is where we do it. Yes, we're losing Dre'Mont Jones and Quintayvious Hutchins on the edge, which stings, but the Jaguars' offense has been pedestrian (9th ranked) and their defense, while solid at 7th, isn't some insurmountable wall. The spread says +3 and Jacksonville's recent form is slightly better than ours (0.16 net EPA per play to our 0.09), but we've had their number before—that 50-10 win in 2021 wasn't a mirage. This is a game we should win if we commit to what we do best.
